A pessoa CX Designer será fundamental na otimização da jornada e experiência do cliente nos canais de comunicação automatizados, com foco em WhatsApp e Chatbot, do nosso parceiro da área de Seguros. O grande desafio como CX Designer será realizar o entendimento aprofundado do fluxo de negócio e garantir a rastreabilidade e medição de toda a experiência por meio de tagueamento (instrumentação) de dados na jornada do cliente. Este profissional atuará como guardião da experiência, transformando dados em insights para desenhar fluxos mais eficientes, intuitivos e que gerem maior satisfação e conversão. Nosso parceiro da área de Seguros busca constantemente aprimorar o design e a operação dos sistemas para garantir que sejam mais escaláveis, confiáveis e eficientes. Então, o papel da pessoa CX Designer é bastante estratégico para o negócio. Para que a estratégia seja assertiva, a pessoa CX Designer fará parte de uma equipe ágil composta por Desenvolvedores, Líderes Técnicos, Analistas de QA, Analistas Funcionais, Product Owners (PO) e Scrum Masters. Garantir a Rastreabilidade da Jornada: O desafio central é desenhar e documentar detalhadamente o tagueamento (instrumentação de dados) em cada ponto de interação da jornada (WhatsApp/Chatbot), garantindo que todos os eventos e gargalos do cliente sejam corretamente identificados e mensurados para análise de dados e Business Intelligence. Otimização Contínua do Fluxo: Identificar e reprojetar os pontos de fricção (pain points), drop-offs e repetição de ciclos na jornada, transformando interações complexas em experiências fluidas e de baixo esforço. Equilibrar Automação e Experiência Humana: Desenhar flows que maximizem a resolução de problemas por automação, mas que garantam uma transição suave e eficiente para o atendimento humano quando necessário, mantendo a voz e a personalidade da marca. Tradução de Requisitos de Negócio em UX Funcional: Converter objetivos de negócio complexos em arquiteturas conversacionais e fluxos de usuário simples e compreensíveis. Requisitos Empatia e Customer Centricity: Capacidade genuína de se colocar no lugar do usuário para identificar pontos de dor e oportunidades de melhoria. Comunicação e Relacionamento Interpessoal: Clareza para articular insights, defender propostas de design e interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. Negociação e Persuasão: Habilidade para influenciar o roadmap do produto e negociar soluções de design que equilibrem a experiência do cliente com os objetivos de negócio e as restrições técnicas. Resiliência e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes dinâmicos e lidar com feedbacks e iterações rápidas, mantendo o foco na melhoria contínua. Organização e Gestão de Fluxo: Proficiência em documentar, organizar e gerenciar a complexidade de fluxos de conversação e jornadas do usuário. Liderança e Proatividade: Iniciativa para conduzir pesquisas, propor soluções e atuar como líder de pensamento em UX dentro da equipe.  Requisitos técnicos (hard skills) Experiência Comprovada em Design Conversacional (Conversational UX/CUX): Sólida experiência no design de chatbots, URA e jornadas no WhatsApp, incluindo a criação de flows (fluxos), scripts e personas conversacionais. Mapeamento de Jornada e Fluxos: Domínio em ferramentas e metodologias para mapear jornadas do usuário, blueprints de serviço e diagramas de fluxo de alta complexidade. Tagueamento e Instrumentação de Dados (Analytics): Experiência em definir a estratégia e os requisitos de tagueamento (instrumentação) para mensuração de métricas de UX e negócio (ex: Drop-off Rate, Taxa de Sucesso, CSAT conversacional). Prototipação e Testes: Proficiência em ferramentas de prototipação (Figma, Miro ou similar) e experiência na condução de testes de usabilidade, A/B testing e análise heurística em canais conversacionais. Conhecimento de Plataformas de Chatbot/WhatsApp: Familiaridade com as limitações e capacidades de plataformas populares de construção de chatbots e APIs de WhatsApp Business. UX Research: Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas para fundamentar decisões de design (entrevistas, análise de logs de conversação, pesquisa de satisfação). Conceitos Ágeis: Experiência de trabalho em squads ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e colaboração estreita com Product Owners (PO) e engenheiros.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

This role will oversee the entire revenue lifecycle across Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, and Customer Success Ops, ensuring alignment, efficiency, and growth across each stage of the customer journey. About Latitude.sh  Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world. Summary  The Supply Chain Analyst will play a key role in developing and managing Latitude.sh’s capacity planning and vendor analysis framework across global data center operations — including space, power, network, and servers. Working closely with Procurement, Operations, and Finance teams, the analyst will anticipate capacity requirements, evaluate vendor proposals, and deliver clear reporting that guides infrastructure and procurement strategy.  Key Responsibilities   Capacity Planning & Forecasting  Develop and maintain comprehensive capacity planning models for data center space, power, servers, and network resources such as IP transit and backbone connectivity.  Forecast utilization to identify where capacity constraints may occur across the global portfolio.  Track provisioned versus active usage and provide early visibility into expansion needs.  Maintain dashboards showing available capacity, forecasted growth, and expected exhaustion timelines by site and service type.  Vendor Evaluation & Cost Analysis  Analyze and compare vendor proposals and quotes for data center colocation, IP transit, backbone, and related network services.  Build standardized cost‑comparison models to identify the most cost‑efficient vendor options.  Support procurement decisions with clear, data‑driven recommendations and total cost analyses.  Monitor vendor pricing, terms, and performance to ensure competitiveness and long‑term value.  Operational Reporting & Insights  Develop and manage a monthly reporting package or dashboard showing month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year variances in data center and network costs, and aggregate breakdowns by region, vendor, and service category.  Compare committed capacity versus billed actuals to identify underutilized or overextended resources and ensure full use of contracted commitments.  Validate and reconcile data across Finance and Operations to ensure reporting accuracy.  Present insights and recommendations that inform vendor selection, cost optimization, and capacity planning across teams.    Skills And Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).  2+ years of experience in supply chain analysis, capacity planning, cost management, or financial analysis, ideally within technology, telecommunications, or data center environments.  Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, scenario modeling).  Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.  Fluent in Portuguese, with professional‑level English (written and spoken).  Background in data center operations, network procurement, or telecom cost modeling (IP transit, dark fiber, backbone).    Preferred   Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and SQL or other data tools.  Exposure to DCIM, NetBox, or other infrastructure inventory systems.  Highly analytical and detail‑oriented, with strong quantitative reasoning.  Organized and methodical, capable of structuring complex datasets into clear insights.  Proactive and forward‑looking, anticipating capacity and cost challenges.  Excellent communication and presentation skills, effective with both technical and business audiences.  Collaborative and dependable, thriving in a dynamic, global environment.    What do we offer? As part of our team, you won't be lost in the crowd – you'll be an essential contributor, making a real impact from day one.  Our values at Latitude.sh guide us in all our work and partnerships. vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Mecânico industrial C em limeira. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Analista de Gente & Gestão Pleno na Agropalma | Limeira  Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.  Estamos em busca de umMECÃNICO INDUSTRIAL C para a região de LIMEIRA/SÃO PAULO.   Descrição Breve do Cargo:    Realizar manutenção preventiva e/ou corretiva em compressores de ar, trocadores de calor, sistemas de vapor e condensado, bombas centrifugas, helicoidais e dosadoras;  Recolocar vedações das placas do filtro, desmontando partes mecânicas, conjuntos e subconjuntos, substituindo peças, efetuando a montagem dos equipamentos, verificando o funcionamento dentro dos padrões preestabelecidos;  Participar da realização de serviços de manutenção de maior grau de complexidade; efetuando a desmontagem, substituição de peças e montagem de conjuntos e subconjuntos;  Realizar correções de baixo rendimento, removendo, limpando e recolocando placas de filtros, trocando anéis de vedação e fazendo ajustes.    Instrução    Ensino Médio Completo e Curso técnico em Mecânica/Mecatrônica;  Experiência de 6 meses em funções semelhantes.    Localidade   Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.  Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).  Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Creative Strategist (DTC E-Commerce)  Location:  Remote  Working Hours:  Monday to Friday, minimum 4 hours overlap with UK GMT  Contract Type:  Independent contractor  You write ads that sell. You can watch a winning VSL and break down exactly why it works. You read ad comments sections for fun. You've written scripts that stopped thumbs, moved product, and hit CPA targets, and you can prove it.  If that sounds like you, keep reading.  About Purolabs  Purolabs is an independent, family-run DTC supplements brand based in South London. We have served over 350,000 customers with clean, science-backed supplements. No fillers, no additives, no nonsense. Featured in Vogue, Women’s Health, and Evening Standard, we are a profitable, fast-growing brand proving that natural wellness can be both effective and transparent.  No shareholders to impress. No cutting corners. Just a genuine mission to help people feel better.  The Role  Creative strategy is our biggest growth lever. We are hiring a Creative Strategist to own the full creative system for our paid advertising, from research and ideation through to briefing, production, and performance analysis. You will develop ad concepts, write scripts and copy, create briefs, and work with editors and creators to produce ads that convert at scale.  This is a performance role. Data guides everything. You will live inside our ad accounts, study what’s working, and use those insights to develop the next round of winning creatives. Creative instinct matters, but the numbers have the final say.  Beyond individual ad creation, you will build and refine the system itself: creative roadmaps, testing cadence, playbooks, feedback loops, and production workflows. The goal is a repeatable engine, not a series of one-offs.  Your primary focus is Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Experience with TikTok or YouTube advertising is a bonus.  What You’ll Do  Research & Insight   Mine customer reviews, surveys, forums, and ad comments to understand the language, pain points, and motivations of our audience  Monitor competitor ads, offers, angles, and landing pages across the DTC landscape  Turn research into clear hypotheses and test plans grounded in consumer psychology    Creative Development   Develop ad concepts, hooks, angles, and scripts for video ads, VSLs, and UGC content  Write direct-response copy for static ads, carousels, and advertorials  Create detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators  Own landing page strategy and messaging for paid campaigns, working with the team to build high-converting pages  Build and maintain a library of proven hooks, frameworks, and winning ad structures    Performance & Iteration   Analyse ad account data to identify winning patterns, fatiguing creatives, and new opportunities  Iterate on winning ads at scale, producing variations of hooks, body copy, CTAs, and visual treatments  Run a tight feedback loop: learn from data, iterate on what works, kill what doesn’t  Present weekly creative performance reports with clear recommendations for what to test next    Process & Production   Maintain a strong creative cadence: roadmap, launch schedule, timelines, and quality control  Manage creative production flow, approvals, and external vendors  Build and refine playbooks, workflows, and processes to improve creative output over time  Collaborate with our Performance Marketing Manager, designers, video editors, and UGC creators    What We’re Looking For  Essential   3+ years of experience in direct-response creative strategy for DTC e-commerce (brand-side, agency, or freelance)  Proven track record writing ad scripts, VSL scripts, and static ad copy that delivered measurable results  Strong understanding of direct-response copywriting principles (AIDA, PAS, and similar frameworks)  Deep knowledge of Meta Ads platform and experience working in high-volume creative testing environments  Experience creating detailed creative briefs and managing creative production workflows  Strong understanding of consumer psychology, buyer motivation, and what makes people click  Ability to analyse ad performance data and translate insights into actionable creative direction  Experience using AI tools like Claude and Gemini  Excellent written English, clear and persuasive    Nice to Have   Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or beauty DTC brands  TikTok or YouTube advertising experience  Experience casting and managing UGC creators  Familiarity with tools like Foreplay, Motion, Triple Whale, or Meta Ad Library  Landing page copywriting or CRO experience  Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar)  Basic design skills (Figma or Canva) for static ad concepts    You’ll Thrive Here If You Are   Data-obsessed.  You make creative decisions based on evidence, not gut feeling. You would rather test than argue.  Commercially minded.  You care about ROAS and CPA, not just aesthetics. A beautiful ad that does not convert is a failed ad.  Fast-moving.  You can produce and iterate at pace without sacrificing quality. Speed and volume matter in creative testing.  Proactive.  You do not wait to be told what to test next. You bring ideas to the table constantly.  Detail-oriented.  Your briefs are clear. Your scripts are tight. You spot what others miss.  A student of the game.  You are constantly saving ads, studying hooks, and analysing what’s working across DTC.    What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)   Creative strategy is fully owned and running as a consistent, repeatable system  You have deep customer understanding and clear positioning across the funnel  You have made measurable impact on ad performance through stronger creative strategy and faster iteration  Creative roadmap, playbooks, and production workflows are documented and running smoothly    What We Offer   Fully remote, work from anywhere with at least 4 hours daily overlap with UK timezone  Competitive rate based on experience  Paid time off including UK bank holidays  Creative freedom to test bold ideas and own your work from concept to results  Direct collaboration with founders, no layers of management  A small, dedicated team that values transparency, results, and doing things the right way  Products that genuinely help people feel better    How to Apply  Your application must include:   Your CV  in English  A portfolio of ad creative work.  Show us ads you have written or developed, with context on the results they drove. This can be a PDF, website, Google Drive link, or Notion page. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.  A short Vocaroo recording (2-3 minutes)  introducing yourself, what you have worked on, and why this role interests you. Applications without a Vocaroo will not be considered.    This is a remote independent contractor role, not employment. Applications are welcome globally.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

You collaborate with partners and customers to design and build solutions in Taktile\'s Agentic Decisioning Platform.  You lead proof-of-value projects and can communicate the value opportunity of a full implementation and the corresponding strategic roadmap to senior stakeholders up to C-level executives. You lead the discovery for new use cases and implement them on the platform to assess product-solution fit. You are comfortable explaining how a model works to both a technical stakeholder such as a CTO and domain experts such as Credit Risk Managers  You have acquired domain expertise in the financial services industry (banking, insurance, capital markets, payments, etc.).   Our Offer Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply  We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. By combining AI with a rich ecosystem of financial data, Taktile enables companies to adapt their decision-making in real time as markets, customer behavior, and risks evolve. Our mission is to build the world’s leading platform for automated decision-making in financial services — setting the standard for how AI is applied responsibly and effectively in this industry. Today, our team works across Berlin, London, and New York, bringing together engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers from companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, as well as fast-growing startups and enterprise leaders. Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.  About us   Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.  Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry‑first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.  We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top‑notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high‑growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino’s, and the list goes on.  Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman‑founded, women‑led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it – see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.  From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world‑class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.  Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting‑edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.  What You Will Do   Negotiate with suppliers to get the best proposal for services or products.  Control budget requests and ensure they are accurate.  Monitor, control, and request office inventory of materials and supplies.  Register and control the entry and exit of vendors.  Control and catalog the company's fixed assets (laptops, furniture, printers, etc.).  Develop and ensure internal policies (reimbursements, travel, asset replacement, etc.).  Manage service provider contracts (cleaning, air conditioning maintenance, IT, etc.).  Request and follow up on building and corrective maintenance (cleaning, air conditioning maintenance, IT, etc.).  Update, monitor, and provide company certificates (usually requested by sales).  Control and record accounts payable and receivable.  Support the collection of overdue client payments.  Assist in the preparation of financial reports.  Organize and archive physical and digital documents.  Support audits.  Manage onboarding and offboarding of employees, including building access.  Support corporate events.    What You Will Need   Hold or are finishing a degree in Finance, Business, Management, or a related field  Are a fast learner with a proactive, dynamic, and self‑directed approach  Have up to 2 years of experience in similar roles or are a new graduate eager to learn  Are detail‑oriented and highly organized  Have a good understanding of how invoicing works, including processes through platforms like municipal systems or NetSuite  Have experience with office management and facilities  Possess advanced English proficiency (you will use it daily, and we will also have interviews in English)  Enjoy working in a multicultural environment and can communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders in a fast‑paced startup environment    What We Offer   We offer many hard and soft skills training opportunities to help you improve and challenge yourself. You’ll have access to 16,000+ online courses taught by real‑world professionals on the LinkedIn Learning platform to satisfy your hunger for knowledge.  You’ll have space to share your skills through training and workshops if you wish. Sharing is caring!  We’ll provide you with a paid Spotify account subscription, so you can cozy up in your headset cocoon whenever you want.  You’ll have a chance to work in an international, diverse, and inclusive environment.  Our working model embraces the best of both worlds with a delightful hybrid approach, where we head to the office three times a week to foster creativity, collaboration, and a vibrant team spirit.  You’ll be part of an industry that’s shaping the future of customer experiences.  Don’t believe us? Just ask Google.    R$0 - R$0 a month  We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there. To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good‑hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile. If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.  We provide equal opportunity in a zero‑discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.  Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Technical Support Maintenance Specialist
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Technical Support Maintenance Specialist em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Customer at TRACTIAN  The Customer team is the driving factor behind lifetime value, retention and expasion at Tractian. We focus on expanding inside existing customers, crosselling to different products, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, Suzano, PepsiCo, and others. Every member of our team directly affects the results of our clients. As part of this team, you will be in contact with clients to understand their needs and help create solutions to improve their maintenance processes.  What you'll do  As a Technical Support Maintenance at TRACTIAN, you will provide specialized technical assistance to our clients, focusing on solving complex engineering problems and ensuring the effective use of our software and hardware solutions. In addition to building relationships with clients, you will perform analyses of mechanical, electrical, and operational spectra, interpret technical drawings, and continuously seek opportunities for improvement to optimize client operations.   Responsibilitiers Develop and maintain close relationships with the customer base, ensuring clear and effective communication. Investigate and diagnose technical issues, providing accurate and timely solutions, including solving complex engineering problems. Work closely with the development team to report bugs and suggest improvements based on client feedback and needs. Provide technical support through our Helpdesk, email, and remote sessions, resolving client issues quickly and efficiently. Manage support activities and client interactions through our Helpdesk, and document actions in the HubSpot CRM, ensuring accurate and accessible records. Develop a deep understanding of TRACTIAN products, correlating features with client operations to identify and suggest improvements and new tools. Assist in creating and maintaining support documentation and knowledge bases, sharing your technical expertise with the team and clients. Analyze mechanical, electrical, and operational spectra, interpret technical drawings, and understand industrial processes, including knowledge of PPCM (Planning, Programming, and Control of Maintenance) and its operational routines. Be proactive in seeking improvement opportunities, focusing on enhancing operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.  Requirements Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, such as Electrical, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering. Experience in providing technical support for software or technology products. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Knowledge of troubleshooting and diagnostic techniques. Proficiency in technical support tools and Helpdesk software, especially Intercom. Ability to document technical information for a non-technical audience. Genuine listening skills and an obsession with customer satisfaction, with a focus on delivering exceptional service. Knowledge of different industrial processes and PPCM (Planning, Programming, and Control of Maintenance) and its operational routines.  Bonus Points CATV II or III certification. Prior experience in B2B technical support roles. Additional language skills apart from English. Fluent in English.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

 Conferir a quantidade de animais em cada recinto, seguindo os protocolos definidos;  Realizar manejos agendados ou emergenciais para contenção física, conforme estabelecido em protocolos que visem movimentação de animais, incluindo recebimento e/ou destinação para instituições externas;  Realizar as atividades sob sua responsabilidade, utilizando equipamento de proteção individual e de proteção coletiva;  Contribuir com a recepção de estagiários compartilhando os conhecimentos adquiridos e a rotina de atividades; Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Você é alguém que aplica conhecimento de negócios e mercado para promover os objetivos da organização? Você é alguém capaz de criar novas e melhores maneiras de a organização ter sucesso? Se a resposta é “sim”, venha e junte-se a nós. A SIG é o lugar onde você pode construir algo incrível. Nós oferecemos uma remuneração competitiva e a oportunidade de trabalho remoto em regime parcial. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira; um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio. A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor. Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange. Join to apply for the Especialista em Ciência de Dados  role at Mercado Libre  No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte desse propósito! Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários. Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro quanto fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico. Para milhões de comércios, empreendimentos e profissões, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina. Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades das pessoas para as quais prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma. Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:  Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites; Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação; Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros; A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas; Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão; Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.  Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:  Desenhar, desenvolver e implantar modelos de Machine Learning focados em resolver problemas de negócio de alto impacto em serviços de Fintech; Traduzir problemas de negócio em problemas de modelagem, definindo hipóteses, variáveis, métricas de sucesso e estratégias de experimentação, garantindo o alinhamento com as prioridades do time e da organização; Planejar e executar experimentos e análises de impacto, garantindo rigor estatístico, desenho adequado de grupos de controle e leitura correta de resultados; Definir, acompanhar e comunicar KPIs de performance dos modelos, desde métricas técnicas (ex.: AUC, precisão, recall, uplift) até métricas de negócio (ex.: receita incremental, redução de churn, aumento de engajamento); Desenvolver análises exploratórias e diagnósticas em grandes volumes de dados, gerando insights que suportem decisões estratégicas, mesmo quando não há uso direto de modelos (por exemplo, extração de dados, cruzamento de bases, validação de hipóteses); Atuar como ponte entre o time técnico e as áreas de negócios, articulando claramente trade-offs entre soluções rápidas (MVPs, análises pontuais, modelos mais simples) e desenvolvimentos mais robustos e complexos, que exigem mais tempo; Ajudar a desenhar roadmaps de projetos, incluindo priorização de iniciativas, estimativa e justificativa de esforços, riscos, dependências e critérios de sucesso; Garantir a qualidade ao longo do ciclo de vida dos modelos, desde o entendimento do dado, preparação e feature engineering, até monitoramento em produção e revisão de performance; Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, negócios, engenharia de dados, engenharia de software) para viabilizar soluções ponta a ponta, desde a concepção até a implementação e acompanhamento em produção; Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre técnicas de modelagem, inferência causal, ferramentas de dados e tendências de mercado, compartilhando aprendizados com o time.  Requisitos:  Ter experiência mínima de 3–5 anos atuando com Ciência de Dados em startups, bancos, big techs ou consultorias, preferencialmente no setor de serviços financeiros; Experiência comprovada na construção, validação e acompanhamento de modelos de Machine Learning em ambiente de negócio; Proficiência em SQL, com capacidade de trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados, escrever queries complexas, realizar cruzamentos de múltiplas fontes e otimizar consultas; Proficiência em Python; Facilidade de comunicação e colaboração com áreas não técnicas, atuando como facilitador(a) na interface entre tecnologia e negócios; Perfil empreendedor, proativo e motivado por ambientes dinâmicos, mudanças rápidas e projetos desafiadores.  Nós lhe propomos:  Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo; Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores; Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas; Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)  O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Spark Developer Senior
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Spark Developer Senior em pompeia. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Outras localidades: Em qualquer lugar do País  Remuneração: Pacote a ser detalhado  Data da abertura da vaga: 4 de dez. de 2025  Descrição da oportunidade  ID da requisição:    Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.  Em Tech Financial Services (Tech FSO), estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando as necessidades e desafios tecnológicos dos nossos clientes do segmento financeiro (Mercado de Capitais, Bancos, Fintechs, Seguros e Gestão de Ativos). Entregamos soluções sob medida com base nas necessidades específicas de cada negócio, a partir de uma equipe multidisciplinar de especialistas com diferentes perfis, como especialistas em Dados, UX, até analistas de negócios e scrum masters.  Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?   Como Desenvolvedor Spark , você irá atuar em cliente de grande porte em projeto internacional, com oportunidade de crescimento em frentes diversas para o segmento financeiro. Você poderá contar com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e estar pronto/a para construir um mundo de negócios melhor para nossas pessoas, clientes e as comunidades que nos apoiam.  Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:   Graduação em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados ou área relacionada;  Inglês Avançado/Fluente - C2 (haverá contato com cliente internacional);  Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, com forte foco em Apache Spark, Java e AWS;  Proficiência em frameworks e ferramentas de processamento de dados, particularmente com Spark SQL e DataFrames;  Sólido conhecimento dos serviços AWS, incluindo EMR, S3, Glue e Redshift;  Excelentes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.    Principais responsabilidades:    Projetar, desenvolver e manter aplicações de processamento de dados escaláveis usando Apache Spark com Java na AWS;  Colaborar com engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e partes interessadas do negócio para coletar requisitos e traduzi-los em especificações técnicas;  Otimizar trabalhos do Spark para desempenho e eficiência, garantindo um processamento de dados de alta qualidade;  Implementar melhores práticas em engenharia de dados, incluindo ingestão, transformação e armazenamento de dados;  Trabalhar com serviços da AWS, como EMR, S3, Glue e Redshift, para construir e implantar soluções de dados;  Realizar revisões de código e fornecer mentoria a desenvolvedores juniores, promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua;  Solucionar e resolver problemas em aplicações de processamento de dados existentes, garantindo desempenho e confiabilidade ideais;  Manter-se atualizado com as últimas tecnologias e tendências do setor para aprimorar continuamente as práticas de desenvolvimento.    O que oferecemos:  Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Wellhub, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios .  Quem somos : Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.  Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias. Segundo o Great Place to Work 2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil, e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Assim, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.  Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!   Saiba mais sobre como é trabalhar na EY:  Oportunidade disponível em modelo presencial (com flexibilidade para o remoto) nos escritórios da EY em todo o Brasil.   A EY acredita na igualdade de oportunidades. Independentemente de gênero, idade, raça, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados em nossos processos.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Customer Success Manager
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Customer Success Manager em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

## Job Description# The world of customer experience isn’t just evolving—it’s being revolutionized. At Zendesk, we don’t watch the future unfold. We build it. As the architects of the AI-powered Resolution Platform, we’re resetting the standard for what customer service—and customer success—can mean on a global stage.## **Mission**Consider the Zendesk Customer Success Manager (CSM) role if you are ready to be a pioneer in the future of Customer Experience (CX). This is a dynamic advisory position that puts you at the forefront of leveraging Zendesk's cutting-edge AI technologies to guide customers directly to their desired business outcomes. You will gain full ownership of your customer relationships, acting as an orchestrator and strategic partner, responsible for driving product adoption, articulating clear ROI, and accelerating growth. If you are driven by accountability, have a strong technical understanding of SaaS/AI, and want to make an outsized impact on customer success and Zendesk's growth trajectory, this role offers the perfect platform for innovation and career acceleration.## **Overarching Objective for the role:*** Proactive customer health management through intentional, outcome-driven customer engagement, leveraging Zendesk’s advanced solutions, including cutting-edge AI technologies.* Product adoption acceleration and value realization, acting as an evangelist for Zendesk’s AI and automation capabilities, partnering with customers to articulate ROI and provide tailored adoption roadmaps.* Cultivating, strengthening, and accelerating growth of Zendesk customer relationships by applying technical understanding of Zendesk’s products and AI capabilities to advise customers on solution fit, configuration, and integration.## **How You’ll Make an Impact*** Take full ownership of customer relationships, proactively managing their success throughout the entire lifecycle—from onboarding and outcome realization to renewal. You will be accountable for customer health, retention, and advocacy, always seeking new ways to add value.* Deliver outcome-driven engagement across each stage of the customer journey by leveraging customer experience (CX) management best practices. You’ll design and execute success plans, coordinate onboarding with Professional Services, and continuously optimize the customer experience.* Champion product adoption and value realization, acting as an evangelist for Zendesk’s AI and automation capabilities. You will partner with customers to articulate ROI, provide tailored adoption roadmaps, and celebrate success.* Apply your technical understanding of Zendesk’s products and AI capabilities to advise customers on solution fit, configuration, and integration. You’ll serve as a knowledgeable guide for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating features into real-world value.* Identify commercial opportunities within your accounts by maintaining commercial acumen—spotting whitespace for expansion, leading renewals based on demonstrated business impact, and driving revenue growth through strategic engagement.* Use analytical capability to interpret customer data and health metrics, proactively uncover trends, and make informed recommendations. You’ll prioritize accounts, forecast renewals, and surface risks and opportunities using data-driven insights.* Build strategic partnerships with customers by operating as a trusted advisor. You’ll facilitate long-term success planning, foster executive relationships, and collaborate cross-functionally to align on mutual goals and innovation.**What You’ll Need to Succeed**## **Customer Focus & Ownership*** Proven track record of taking customer ownership: demonstrating accountability for outcomes and proactively driving customer value across the relationship.* Experience in CX management, orchestrating seamless end-to-end experiences, gathering and applying feedback, and working toward continuous improvement.## **Business Acumen & Strategy*** Business-oriented mindset with commercial acumen: able to understand customer business models, identify opportunities for growth, and connect product adoption to revenue drivers.* Ability to form strategic partnerships—developing deep, consultative relationships, co-developing success plans, and serving as an innovation partner.### **Technical & Product Expertise*** Strong technical understanding—comfortable learning new technologies and quickly grasping Zendesk’s advanced AI features, integrations, and scalability.* Natural adoption and value evangelist who passionately champions Zendesk’s full potential, coaches stakeholders on new capabilities, and communicates impact to drive both engagement and retention.### **Data & Analytical Skills*** Analytical capability: skilled in interpreting customer usage data, monitoring health scores, quantifying impact of adoption, and prioritizing actions based on analysis.### ## Your Background:* Must have a minimum of 5+ years of related experience in Customer Success / Experience* Previous experience in go-to-customer/GTM roles in enterprise technology / SaaS — either customer success management, professional services/consulting, technical account management, or solutions engineering/pre-sales consulting* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar).* Experience supporting and driving adoption of SaaS or AI-powered solutions in customer-facing roles.* Ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels, both internally and externally.* Proficiency with customer success tools (e.g., Gainsight) and basic quantitative analysis.* Strong program/project management and multitasking skills.#LI-MR7Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.**The intelligent heart of customer experience**Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster  in the workplace. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please .Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e-mail to   with#J-18808-Ljbffr

Gerente Técnico - Nutrição de Ruminantes Gerente Técnico - Nutrição de Ruminantes Ajinomoto do Brasil, empresa do Grupo Ajinomoto, líder mundial em aminoácidos, com longa experiencia e tradição no desenvolvimento, produção e comercialização de aminoácidos para a nutrição animal, busca profissional para a posição de Gerente de Área (G1), Departamento de Marketing Técnico, Unidade de Negócios – Nutrição Animal, orientado a resultados. Este profissional será responsável por planejar, desenvolver e executar estratégias de marketing técnico em nutrição animal com o objetivo de aumentar a participação da empresa, na América Latina, nos diversos segmentos da produção animal e com foco na bovinocultura de leite e de corte. Devendo colaborar com as equipes envolvidas nos negócios, analisar o desempenho dos planos e ações executadas, gerar relatórios para a equipe de gestão e gerenciar o orçamento, otimizando as despesas e maximizando o retorno dos investimentos. Responsabilidades e atribuições  Profissional com habilidades e conhecimentos para planejar e executar estratégias de desenvolvimento e de marketing técnico em nutrição de ruminantes, altamente colaborativo com as equipes envolvidas nos negócios de nutrição animal (ruminantes e monogástricos). Conhecimento e habilidades para formular rações para animais e para a promoção e suporte técnico aos produtos da área de negócios. vagas.title: Human Resources Director Brazil
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Human Resources Director Brazil em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

At Diaverum , we are looking for a business-oriented and hands-on HR Director  to lead our HR function in Brazil. This role is critical in attracting, developing, and retaining top talent  while ensuring a positive, inclusive, and compliant  work environment. Everyone deserves a fulfilling life. That’s why we’re dedicated to enhancing the lives of renal patients.  As a global leader and the largest independent renal service provider in Europe, we have 13,000 healthcare professionals caring for around 41,000 patients across 450 clinics in 24 countries globally . We provide renal care personalized to patients’ needs and choices, offering a portfolio of treatments ranging from preventive care, hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and home care, to the coordination of patients’ comorbidities and holiday dialysis. Our vision is to transform renal care, delivering and broadening access to the highest quality of kidney care for patients around the world . At the heart of what we do is our standardized care delivery model, continuously evolving digital & AI infrastructure and people caring for patients with competence, passion and inspiration.  Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, Diaverum is part of the M42 group of companies , a first-of-its-kind integrated health powerhouse committed to the sustainable future of health. Diaverum Brazil ranks first in the number of patients within the Diaverum group and is the second-largest player in the Brazilian market. The company provides renal services through its own clinics and as a third-party provider for hospitals, treating 4,500 chronic patients across 12 clinics, performing 75,000 treatments per month. Headquartered in São Paulo, its clinics are located in the São Paulo metropolitan region and the state of Sergipe, while also serving hospitals in São Paulo, Sergipe, Bahia, and João Pessoa. Diaverum Brazil has a team of 1,200 direct employees and 200 contracted nephrologists. The HR team consists of 16 members, with two based at the headquarters and the rest distributed across the clinics. With an average business growth of over 30% per year, the company is currently developing and deploying HR IT systems in a dynamic, flexible, and multidisciplinary environment. As a key member of the Management Team , you will play a pivotal role in driving the HR strategy, talent development, employee relations, and compliance with local labour laws , ensuring alignment with global HR standards  and company goals. Reporting to the Country Manager Brazil, this role is based in São Paulo (headquarters in the Vila Olímpia neighborhood) and requires between 20% and 40% local travel. Develop and implement a business-driven HR strategy , supporting the organizational structure with leadership. Act as an ambassador and change agent , ensuring that Diaverum’s culture and values  are a living reality. Represent HR in the Country Management Team  and Brazil in the global HR team , contributing to continuous improvement projects. Be a visible and hands-on  partner for senior leaders, managers, and employees. Ensure labour law compliance  and provide guidance on employment matters. Equip clinic managers with HR tools  to become strong “people managers.” Support in talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, and development . Oversee payroll, contracts, and HR administration . Manage the full employee lifecycle , including recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and performance reviews. Support M&A activities , ensuring a seamless HR operational transition . Lead workforce planning , ensuring talent attraction and retention. Contribute to budget planning  and labour efficiency initiatives  with Finance and Operations. Measure and report on key HR data  to drive decision-making. Develop and implement HR policies and procedures  aligned with corporate standards. Ensure HR tools are available and used effectively across the business. Educate managers and employees on HR processes, including creating employee handbooks and onboarding materials.  People & Organizational Development  Lead organizational design initiatives with the management team. Drive learning & development, ensuring training programs support business needs. Oversee employee onboarding, ensuring a strong integration into Diaverum’s culture and values. Lead succession planning for key management roles and specialists. Implement the annual performance appraisal process, ensuring clear goal setting and development plans. Support restructuring initiatives to optimize the organization’s effectiveness. Oversee payroll and benefits administration , ensuring compliance and efficiency. Implement a structured annual compensation review process  based on market benchmarks and performance. Develop compensation strategies  that drive a high-performance culture .  ABOUT YOU  You have 8-10 years of experience  in HR across multiple disciplines and a proven track record  in leading change within multilevel organizations . Your strong business acumen  allows you to align HR strategies with company goals, and you have an in-depth understanding of Brazilian labour law . You have worked in an international environment , and if you have experience in the healthcare industry , that’s a big plus. You hold a university degree in HR, Finance, or a related field , and you are fluent in English . You are comfortable using MS Office  and other HR tools to support business operations. You are a customer-focused HR leader  with strong relationship-building skills. You take a hands-on approach , ensuring HR strategies are not only well-designed but also effectively executed. Your communication, listening, and coaching skills  allow you to support both employees and managers, creating a positive and productive work environment. As a change agent , you have the ability to lead HR transformations and integration processes, making a real impact on the business. You have a continuous improvement mindset , always striving to optimize processes and enhance the employee experience. If you have experience in an international company  and a background in the healthcare industry , that would be a plus! If you’re ready to take on a strategic and operational HR leadership role  in a fast-paced, global environment , we’d love to hear from you! Apply now or reach out for more details. At Diaverum, we value diversity and are committed to equal opportunities. We strive to create an inclusive workplace environment for everyone, welcoming applicants regardless of ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, age, or marital status.  #J-18808-Ljbffr

Sobre nós  Somos uma indústria especializada em soluções tecnológicas para a manutenção preditiva em ativos industriais. O objetivo da nossa solução é transformar a indústria, tornando-a mais segura e mais produtiva que ontem. Ao produzirmos os hardwares e softwares da nossa solução, buscamos apresentar aos nossos clientes e parceiros o porquê de sermos referência em soluções eficientes e eficazes para monitoramento, manutenção e performance de ativos.  Além disso, temos orgulho em possuir as certificações das ISOs 9001, 27001, 27018, 27701. Por meio delas, promovemos a organização e a estrutura de nossos processos, resultando em um ambiente de trabalho mais organizado e eficiente, através de uma cultura interna onde os funcionários são incentivados a buscar a excelência em suas atividades, com oportunidades regulares de aprendizado e desenvolvimento profissional.  Conheça mais sobre nós, visite nosso site.  Sobre a equipe na qual você irá atuar  Você fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar dedicada ao desenvolvimento de soluções voltadas para manutenção preditiva de ativos industriais, com foco em ferramentas de análise de vibração e diagnóstico de falhas apoiado por inteligência artificial.  Nossa missão é gerar valor para inspetores e analistas por meio de tecnologias que combinam processamento de sinais, modelos de IA e interfaces intuitivas. A equipe é composta por desenvolvedores front-end e back-end, profissionais de QA, gerentes de produto e designers, todos comprometidos com a entrega de uma experiência de usuário eficiente, confiável e impactante.  Trabalhamos em parceria direta com outras equipes de desenvolvimento de software e de pesquisa e inovação, colaborando na evolução contínua da Plataforma Dynamox, que integra diversas funcionalidades voltadas à confiabilidade de ativos industriais. Interpretar protótipos gráficos e wireframes, trabalhando em conjunto com designers e gerentes de produto para transformar interfaces em experiências funcionais e acessíveis.  Integrar aplicações front-end a APIs e sistemas externos, assegurando comunicação eficiente entre os componentes da plataforma.  Participar de práticas colaborativas, como pair programming, code reviews e discussões técnicas, contribuindo para a evolução contínua do produto e da equipe.  Gerenciar suas próprias tarefas, atuando com autonomia e responsabilidade dentro de um ambiente ágil e multidisciplinar.  Aplicar e disseminar boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo padrões de projeto, testes automatizados e versionamento de código.  Contribuir para a segurança da informação e privacidade de dados, adotando práticas seguras no desenvolvimento e no uso de dados sensíveis.    Requisitos   Experiência com JavaScript, React, HTML e CSS para desenvolvimento de aplicações web.  Conhecimento em ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento front-end como Vite ou Webpack.  Familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código e trabalho colaborativo.  Familiaridade com ferramentas como Figma para consultar especificações de layout e estilo de interfaces.  Disposição para evolução constante e aprendizado de novas tecnologias.    Desejáveis   Experiência com TypeScript em projetos React.  Experiência com bibliotecas de componentes UI como Material UI e Styled Components.  Familiaridade com bibliotecas de gerenciamento de estado, como React Context, Redux ou similares.  Experiência com testes automatizados utilizando ferramentas como Vitest ou Jest.  Conhecimento em bibliotecas de visualização de dados como D3, Highcharts, Plotly ou similares.  Noções de deploy de aplicações front-end em ambientes de nuvem, como Vercel, AWS ou Google Cloud.  Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento, como Sentry, New Relic, Datadog ou similares.  Experiência com CI/CD pipelines, especialmente em ambientes que utilizam GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares. Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de software. vagas.title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Engineering Manager, MAAS em espumoso. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Overview  Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.  We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team . Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We are hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.  The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.  Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.  Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.  The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.  Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.  What we are looking for in you   Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science  Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university  Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages  Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)  Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S  Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems  Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills  Experience with agile software development methodologies  Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members  Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments  Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long    Nice-to-have skills   Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue  Data Center infrastructure management and design    What we offer colleagues  We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.   Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!  Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year  Annual compensation review  Recognition rewards  Annual holiday leave  Maternity and paternity leave  Employee Assistance Programme  Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues  Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events    About Canonical  Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.  Canonical is an equal opportunity employer  We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Participar da elaboração e execução do Plano de Ação de Emergência (PAE) e dos simulados de evacuação e resgate na unidade.  Apoiar o desenvolvimento de cultura de segurança comportamental, promovendo a participação e o engajamento das equipes operacionais.  Promover campanhas de sensibilização e programas de cultura de segurança, incentivando comportamento seguro e reporte de desvios.  Apoiar o desenvolvimento de lideranças de segurança (supervisores e encarregados), fortalecendo o papel deles como multiplicadores.  Atuar em conjunto com Geotecnia, Ventilação, Operação de Mina, Manutenção, Saúde Ocupacional e Meio Ambiente, garantindo integração das práticas de segurança. Você terá a oportunidade de estruturar um canal de receita do zero, com liberdade e autonomia, atuando de forma empreendedora. Sua atuação terá visibilidade para a alta liderança da companhia e irá se reportar diretamente para o CRO da Conta Azul. Será necessário aprendizado e entendimento profundo de modelos de franquia e licenciamento, pois esse será o seu principal nicho de atuação inicialmente. Você será responsável por desenvolver negócios e fazer as primeiras vendas para grupos econômicos que tem a necessidade de apurar o resultado financeiro consolidado e que atuam com rede de franqueados / licenciados (PMEs). Portanto, você irá efetuar uma venda consultiva com múltiplos stakeholders (CFO, franqueador/licenciador, unidades franqueadas ou licenciadas). Este é um nicho ainda não explorado pela Conta Azul, apesar de já termos validado essa oportunidade de mercado. A Conta Azul é movida pela crença que todo empreendedor merece ter sucesso. Apesar do dia a dia cheio de responsabilidades, queremos que todo dono de um pequeno negócio consiga tempo para se dedicar ao que sempre sonhou quando decidiu abrir uma empresa. Por isso, usamos a tecnologia para criar uma plataforma em nuvem, onde o empreendedor juntamente com o seu contador, de forma simples e fácil, podem encontrar tudo o que precisam em tempo real. Alimentar CRM com dados estruturados e gerar insights de canal e reportar semanalmente aprendizados, gargalos e potenciais para escala. Habilidade para mapear segmentos, qualificar leads e interpretar padrões de comportamento. Utiliza dados de forma inteligente e sistemática. Faz leitura de dados para construir soluções e tomar as decisões. Acompanha métricas e entende seus reflexos nas estratégias, planos e resultados. Utiliza-se de analises para traduzir contextos. Capacidade de compreender o mercado em que a Conta Azul está inserida, soluções do ERP e as dores dos principais segmentos. Entendimento básico das estruturas operacionais e jurídicas de modelos de franquias e licenciamento. Fluência no uso de ferramentas para gerir pipeline e registrar interações com leads. Capacidade de comunicar ideias com clareza, escutar ativamente e construir relações de confiança com diferentes stakeholders. Inclui habilidade de conduzir negociações complexas, alinhando interesses diversos e gerando acordos mutuamente vantajosos Capacidade de agir com iniciativa, senso de dono e proatividade. Implica não apenas propor soluções, mas liderar sua implementação com foco em impacto e resultados ganha ganha, mesmo diante de incertezas ou recursos limitados Transitar bem entre áreas internas (produto, jurídico, marketing, vendas, finanças) para que tenha sucesso na implementação das novas negociações e garanta as amarrações das negociações e pontos chave de contato para o novo cliente. Disposição para aprender rapidamente sobre os modelos de negócio dos prospects. Orientação a metas, com aprendizado contínuo e ajustes táticos conforme necessário. Além do olhar de crescimento, ter a responsabilidade pelo impacto gerado, considerando implicações de longo prazo para o negócio, os parceiros e os clientes. Agir como dono das iniciativas e dos resultados. Priorizr crescimento sustentável, não apenas números de curto prazo e assumir erros e corrige rapidamente com aprendizado. Compreensão de indicadores como LTV, CAC, NMRR, e lógica de canais indiretos. Habilidade de se comunicar com fluência em inglês. Preparar materiais, realizar benchmarks internacionais. Comunica-se com objetividade e clareza utilizando o idioma. Tem facilidade para conduzir reuniões, benchmarks e discussões em inglês. Consome materiais em inglês e tem habilidade de produzir documentos e materiais no idioma. Conhecimento em plataformas que aumentam produtividade em cadências de contato. Ter experiência em venda de software para franqueadores e/ou licenciadores. MBA ou especialização em áreas correlatas (negócios, estratégia, inovação, etc.). Experiência comprovada +3 anos com desenvolvimento de negócios, parcerias ou expansão de mercado (Preferencialmente ter vendido software para licenciadores e franquadores)  Informações adicionais:  Plano de saúde com cobertura nacional sem desconto da mensalidade ou coparticipação dos Azuis. AI Focus:  We believe AI is a game-changer for sales success. This is a unique opportunity to grow alongside AI technologies that will empower you to work smarter and close more deals.  Other perks at xChange:  36 off days for remote employees outside of Germany, mental healthcare & coaching program, language courses and many more. Software Engineer, Backend (All teams) – Brazil – Vaga para mulheres  Engineering the future of logistics – from Brazil to the world  This role is part of our commitment to increase the representation of women in technology at DoorDash Brazil. We strongly encourage candidates who identify as women to apply.  We are building an engineering team where women have equitable access to opportunity, leadership, and long-term career growth within our São Paulo hub.  At DoorDash, we believe diverse teams build better products. This opportunity is designed to create greater equity in access to engineering roles and long-term career growth within our São Paulo engineering hub.  DoorDash is building the world’s most reliable on-demand logistics platform. As part of our global expansion, we are investing heavily in Brazil and growing our engineering presence in São Paulo. This is a unique opportunity to join one of Silicon Valley’s fastest-growing companies—while staying close to home.  We’re looking for Backend Engineers who are excited to solve real-world problems at scale. You’ll work on product teams or platform teams that power our three-sided marketplace of Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants . From improving restaurant discovery to optimizing delivery logistics, you’ll help shape the experience of millions of users.  You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers—many based in the U.S.—so fluency in English and strong collaboration skills are essential.  What you’ll do   Design, build, and maintain large-scale backend systems used by millions of users  Contribute to our technical roadmap and define the architecture for key product areas  Drive improvements in performance, scalability, reliability, and security  Help transition parts of our monolithic codebase to a microservices architecture  Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Brazil and the U.S.  Work on high-impact features that directly improve the user experience for Dashers, Merchants, or Consumers    We’re excited about you because…   You have 1+ years of experience with backend technologies and distributed systems  You’re comfortable with modern web architecture (HTTP, REST APIs, grpc, microservices)  You’ve worked with relational and non-relational databases  You enjoy solving complex problems with elegant code and clear thinking  You’re fluent in English and confident participating in meetings and code reviews in English  You care about quality and write tests to ensure your code works as expected  You take ownership and enjoy working with autonomy in a fast-paced environment    Nice to haves   Experience working at a tech company with scale  Familiarity with Java, Kotlin, or similar JVM languages  Exposure to big data technologies or event-driven architecture  Interest in mentorship or growing into a technical leadership role    Why join DoorDash Brazil?   Work on a global product, with real impact on millions of people  Be part of a fast-growing engineering hub in São Paulo  Hybrid remote model with great office space in Av. Paulista  English immersion and opportunities to grow your international career  Contribute to a modern, scalable platform used across multiple countries  Build the future of local commerce with a team that values ownership, humility, and getting 1% better every day  Be part of a growing engineering organization committed to building inclusive teams and equitable opportunities    About DoorDash  At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We\'re committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.  Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion  We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.  This position is open to candidates with disabilities. DoorDash welcomes applicants registered with the national autism registry (SisTEA) and others who seek an inclusive workplace. If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

MS in Structural Engineering is a plus.  + Strong knowledge of international engineering standards, codes, and other applicable state and federal guidelines, including but not limited to IBC, ASCE, ASTM, AISC, and ACI.  + Proficiency in finite element analysis software (RISA, STAAD, or equivalent)  + Proficiency in advanced modal and dynamic analysis  + Minimum of 2 years of structural engineering experience, preferably in the solar EPC industry.  + Demonstrated experience in structural design, including dead, live, snow, wind, and seismic loads, as well as steel structure design and construction documentation.  + Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel), AutoCAD,  + Proficiency in foundation tools like LPILE/AllPile, Risa foundation, Staad foundations, Plaxis and other structural analysis tools.  + Proficiency in programming languages is a plus.  + Self-motivated team player with strong communication and collaboration skills.  + Passion for renewable energy and solar power is a plus.  + Fluent English is required to communicate effectively with clients, manage international projects, and produce high-quality technical documentation.At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.# **We are Nextpower**#J-18808-Ljbffr
